summary: Brave Search API offers a Search plan (complete search results with LLM context, $5 per 1,000 requests, 50 queries per second) and an Answers plan (grounded summarized answers, $4 per 1,000 requests plus $5 per million input/output tokens, 2 queries per second). Both include $5 in free credits every month, applied to the account automatically. A credit card is required as an anti-fraud measure; on free plans it only confirms identity and is not charged. Storing API results in whole or part, including for LLM training or tuning, requires a plan explicitly granting storage rights; the free credit itself does not establish those rights. The API grants no rights to third-party webpage content, whose publishers' copyright terms still apply.
claim_steps: Open https://brave.com/search/api/ and choose Get started on the Search or Answers plan
Create an account and add a credit card for identity verification (not charged on free plans)
The $5 monthly free credit is applied to your account automatically

Before storing any API results, including for LLM training or tuning, subscribe to a plan explicitly granting storage rights. Access to third-party webpages must comply with their publishers' copyright terms.
